report: Current API naming and postfix type syntax audit

range_contracts.replaceRange: mutates target range and returns target
range_contracts.splice: mutates target range and returns removed elements
range_contracts.replace: text Pattern replacement returns new char[]; source is not mutated

scope.active_documentation: Root normative TZ and current 1/ docs, receiver contracts, examples and Markdown comparisons were reviewed; final five normative-document edits were included in the final name search.
scope.generated_products: Combined LMX_Receivers.lmx/public.lmx and PDF/XLS/statistics are regenerated and checked by the main build; they are not counted as canonical source files here.

historical_algorithms_type_migration.note: The counters describe distinct kinds of edits, not disjoint changed lines. Source strings generated by historical builders use the same postfix heads. Known historical algorithm limitations remain documented; exact earlier bytes remain in the uploaded archive.

corrected_findings.correction: Graph field address is @D\field, not compact declaration @(D\field).
SelectionSignature@: selected Compatible\choose / Reordered\choose; intended typed requirements retained.
RxSlotPatch@: change is a typed requirement, not an initialized universal reference.
Address-level comment now uses @...[0], with the historical counterpart updated likewise.
LMX capture reference name is sameAs even in prose that also mentions Perl.
Text replace, target-returning replaceRange and removed-elements-returning splice have distinct names and result contracts.

preserved_semantics_and_exclusions.ordinary_reference_initializers: @: ptr value is unchanged. Examples such as @: model Model, @: free Resource and @: payload RxReady... refer to existing values, not to typed requirements.
preserved_semantics_and_exclusions.generic_arrays: []: name and []: name ExistingArray remain valid generic Array declarations; []: [data] is a valid anonymous Structure. They were not blindly rewritten to @[].
preserved_semantics_and_exclusions.other_historical_records: reference supporting documents, historical validation receipts and explicit migration before/after examples retain their historical status.
preserved_semantics_and_exclusions.foreign_api: Foreign-language code and real API spellings are retained, including Python re.fullmatch in audit/generation tools.
preserved_semantics_and_exclusions.migration_metadata: Old names in api_revision_20261122.json, api_renaming_20261122.json, NAMING migration tables and catalog former_name/history columns are historical labels, not active aliases.

final_name_review.splice_note: splice is deliberately excluded from the obsolete-token regex because the new receiver legitimately reuses that name with a different documented result contract.

remaining: 39: direct emptyPattern/neverPattern calls on empty input are not separately written for both boundary predicates.
40: component UTF8/byte/anchor/lookaround fixtures exist; direct combined prefix/suffix observations are not all written.
41: encoding source cases exist; arbitrary dynamic callback declared-failure propagation is a shared-kernel integration gate and has no separate boundary fixture.

procedure: Reapply candidate_patterns to canonical sources and to the listed LMX JSON string selections, reporting file/key/line.
Review Markdown matches in their LMX-versus-foreign and active-versus-historical context. Confirm ordinary @ initializer meaning before any conversion.
Check all reference/pre_* .lmx files with the two type patterns; inspect the four generated typed-reference constructions in the retained generic_functions.lmx.
Resolve fixture IDs in case_traceability to the 57 source entries. Partial source coverage and NOT_RUN are intentional findings, not successes.

limitations: The searches and manual contextual review are not a complete parser, P0 proof, type checker or execution test.
No native/JVM performance or dynamic failure-metadata integration has been validated here.
Counts refer to canonical source material and preserved variants at this revision; generated artifact checks are separate.
